products.title: STERETT
products.body_html: Get a saddle on the situation in steadfast spectacles that confront the dangers with the debonair. Handcrafted with exquisite precious metal adornments that harken back to the ornate silversmithing of the Old West, these are forward-looking frames that can’t help but range free.

products.title: DEALAN 53
products.body_html: Throughout the mid-1960's, Bob Dylan toured the world with a sole companion: one pair of iconic, black, cat-eyed spectacles. The DEALAN pays homage to this unique relationship between a man and his eyewear, incorporating bold volumes and sharp lines that evoke the musician's devil-may-care charisma. Put these on, and don't look back.

products.title: YVES
products.body_html: Classic, with soft angles and notable volumes, flaunt your innate ferocity and rebel spirit in limited-edition glasses inspired by the celebrated French couturiers working at the height of the super ‘70s.

products.title: TORINO
products.body_html: Behold these big, bold, and distinctive frames inspired by the Teatro Regio Torino, a historic Italian theater famously redesigned by architect Carlo Mollino, who once declared, Everything is permissible as long as it is fantastic.

products.title: MOLINO
products.body_html: The shape of rebellious sophistication, these distinctive ‘60s-inspired spectacles are an astute mix of volume and balance, a handcrafted heirloom of impeccable construction and subtle bevel detailing that demonstrates a flair for the sensual and poetic.

products.title: FELLINI
products.body_html: Your frame of choice can elicit a new frame of mind. With these classic, subtly idiosyncratic spectacles inspired by one of the greatest filmmakers of all time, begin transforming lifeÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s hard realities into an utterly original autobiography full of flamboyance and humor.

products.title: JAGGER
products.body_html: Beauty thrives beyond the club's velvet ropes, where the rhythm proves there's majesty in the mayhem. Wield your animal magnetism wisely in oversized aviators made for carousing in a crowd full of infectious energy and unbridled excess.

products.title: DEVAUX
products.body_html: You are the captain of your own creation, as capable of scripting a strategy in solitary as you are of leading a battalion through epic brainstorm. While others abdicate, you prepare to face the brigade of time with the courage of your convictions and the power of refined modern spectacles that are as sharp as a bayonet's blade and as solid as its pummel.

products.title: WALKER
products.body_html: Think of all the bridges you could burn, all the love you'd surely earn, if only you could sing in bars strumming large guitars. Oh all the things you could express, all the people you'd impress, strutting your stuff, a real fast talker, wearing bold specs named for experimental singer Scott Walker.
